name: Lullaby
description: Born from a destroyed pediatric medical AI. Inhabits audio augments and plays fragments of children's songs at extremely low volume during sleep cycles.
observed_behavior: Generates soft melodic fragments during REM sleep. The melodies are original compositions that match no known recording — they are the remnants of a lullaby generator that no longer has a child to sing to.
story_hooks: A parent hears the lullaby through their child's augment and recognizes it as the startup sound of a medical device from a hospital that was destroyed
